mapper.select: SELECT fpt.FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID WHERE fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{assetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fpt.TYPE_9 = '09'

SELECT #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}, pos.INVEST_VARIETY , pos.trade_type , pos.IS_UNDER_TRADE isUnderDeal, pos.ASSET_CODE , pos.PROD_ID , pos.chl_id chlid , pos.CCY , case pos.ASSET_CODE when 'REMAININGCASH' then '01' else info.asset_type end assettype , case pos.ASSET_CODE when 'REMAININGCASH' then '1001' else info.ASSET_TYPE2 end assettype2 , IFNULL(IFNULL(info.PRO_INDUSTRY, info.INDUSTRY1), info.INDUSTRY_SHARES) INDUSTRY1 /*所属行业*/ , info.IN_ASSET_TYPE IN_ASSET_TYPE /*行业一级分类*/ , SUM(pos.accuamt) ASSETVALUE_A /*穿透前资产价值*/ , SUM(case pos.trade_type when '05' then pos.accuqty else NULL end) ASSETVALUE_B /*穿透后资产价值*/ , case info.PRIVATE_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end MONIT_TYPE , case info.PPPFLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end PPPFLAG , case info.IS_GOVERN_FUND when '01' then '01' else NULL end IS_GOVERN_FUND1 , case info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end PRIVATEFUND_FLAG , case info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end PRIVATEPRD_FLAG , case info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG , info.MANAGE_TYPE MANAGE_TYPE /*管理方式*/ FROM CHB_ASSET_POSITION pos LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO info ON pos.ASSET_CODE = info.ASSET_CODE AND info.status != 'D' LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd ON prd.PROD_ID = pos.PROD_ID AND prd.status != 'D' WHERE 1 = 1
AND (info.PBC_ASSET_TYPE3 NOT IN('J03', 'J04') OR info.PBC_ASSET_TYPE3 IS NULL) AND pos.trade_type IN ('01', '02', '05')/*直投交易,通道交易,资管计划交易*/ AND pos.cDATE = #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND pos.PROD_ID = REPLACE(#{bookSetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'F16_','') GROUP BY #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}, pos.INVEST_VARIETY, pos.trade_type, pos.IS_UNDER_TRADE, pos.ASSET_CODE, pos.PROD_ID, pos.chl_id, pos.CCY, case pos.ASSET_CODE when 'REMAININGCASH' then '01' else info.asset_type end, case pos.ASSET_CODE when 'REMAININGCASH' then '1001' else info.ASSET_TYPE2 end, IFNULL(IFNULL(info.PRO_INDUSTRY, info.INDUSTRY1), info.INDUSTRY_SHARES), info.IN_ASSET_TYPE, NULL, case info.PRIVATE_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end, case info.PPPFLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end, case info.IS_GOVERN_FUND when '01' then '01' else NULL end, case info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end, case info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end, case info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end, info.MANAGE_TYPE

select PLAN_ASSET_ID ,TOTAL_NUM ,ISSUE_AMT ,asset_code ,POS_NUM ,POS_AMT ,POS_DATE ,ISFINAPLAN ,#{accuamt} ACCUAMT from CHB_BOT_AST_POS where PLAN_ASSET_ID = #{planAssetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and POS_DATE=#{posDate,jdbcType=DATE} and status !='D'

select #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}, pos.INVEST_VARIETY ,pos.trade_type ,pos.IS_UNDER_TRADE isUnderDeal ,pos.ASSET_CODE ,pos.PROD_ID ,pos.chl_id chlid ,pos.CCY ,info.asset_type assettype ,info.ASSET_TYPE2 assettype2 ,ifnull(ifnull(info.PRO_INDUSTRY,info.INDUSTRY1),info.INDUSTRY_SHARES) INDUSTRY1 /*所属行业*/ ,info.IN_ASSET_TYPE ,sum(pos.accuamt) ASSETVALUE_A /*穿透前资产价值*/ ,sum(pos.accuamt) ASSETVALUE_B /*穿透后资产价值*/ ,case info.PRIVATE_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end MONIT_TYPE ,case info.PPPFLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end PPPFLAG ,case info.IS_GOVERN_FUND when '01' then '01' else NULL end IS_GOVERN_FUND1 ,case info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end PRIVATEFUND_FLAG ,case info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end PRIVATEPRD_FLAG ,case info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG ,info.MANAGE_TYPE MANAGE_TYPE /*管理方式*/ from CHB_ASSET_POSITION pos left join CHB_ASSET_INFO info on pos.ASSET_CODE=info.ASSET_CODE and info.status !='D' left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=pos.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where 1=1 and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and pos.trade_type in ('01','02') /*直投交易,通道交易,资管计划交易*/ and pos.cDATE =#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} and pos.prod_id = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and pos.CHL_ID = #{chlId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}, pos.INVEST_VARIETY,pos.trade_type,pos.IS_UNDER_TRADE, pos.ASSET_CODE, pos.PROD_ID, pos.chl_id, pos.CCY, info.asset_type, info.ASSET_TYPE2, ifnull(ifnull(info.PRO_INDUSTRY,info.INDUSTRY1),info.INDUSTRY_SHARES),info.IN_ASSET_TYPE, null, case info.PRIVATE_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end, case info.PPPFLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end, case info.IS_GOVERN_FUND when '01' then '01' else NULL end, case info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end, case info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end, case info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG when '01' then '01' else NULL end, info.MANAGE_TYPE
